- Library: Chart.js **4.4.1** (MIT licence, see `LICENSE-chart.js.md`)
- File: `chart-4.4.1.umd.js`, copied byte for byte from
  <https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.1/dist/chart.umd.js>
- SHA-256: `74401d738dd3e03ee5dfb3b6841210fe2c4ead8a960c4011ca4ba0b78a9fd8f3`
- Size: 205,125 bytes

The banner comment inside the file is kept. A test (`tests/test_server.py`) checks the file against this hash,
so an edit or a swapped version is caught. To update: download the new file, change the file name in
`studiolib/server.py`, `web/index.html` and this README, and record its hash here.
